description: This file defines a ViewModel class 'SignInViewModel' used for handling a stubbed (offline/demo) sign-in flow in an Android application. It includes methods to start a sign-in process and handle sign-in status, using a local token store.

classes.name: SignInViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing offline sign-in flow for demo builds, providing methods to simulate sign-in process.

methods.name: startGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Simulates a Google sign-in by setting a local token and updating the signed-in state.

methods.name: handleSignIn
methods.description: Handles sign-in status; sets a local token if none exists and updates the signed-in state.
